title: Boxes file mixings
description: Model to inject additional things in a boxes layout definition
$comment: the IDs of the boxes to connect are the keys of the dictionary

title.description: optional title, that's appended to the original layout title

version.description: allows to include a version for the layout description

legend.description: Legend definition used in this diagram

layoutMixins.description: dictionary for layout mixins. key of the dictionary is the caption of the box that will take the additional content
layoutMixins.$comment: attention, take care that the captions used are unique, without that the content my apprear in the wrong place

boxMixins.description: array for box mixins. It's useful in cases where the dictionary reference to boxes to mix in is limiting

formatVariations.description: Set of formats that overwrites the style of boxes, if specific conditions are met

comments.description: dictionary of comment objects, this comment will applied on layout objects and replace existing comments there

tags.description: dictionary of tag array, the additional tags will be applied on the existing layout and can be used for instance to define display formats

images.description: optional map of images used in the generated graphic

steps.description: additional container to allow step separation in workflows

caption.description: title, that's appended to the original layout title

layoutMixins.description: dictionary for layout mixins. key of the dictionary is the caption of the box that will take the additional content
layoutMixins.$comment: attention, take care that the captions used are unique, without that the content my apprear in the wrong place

boxMixins.description: array for box mixins. It's useful in cases where the dictionary reference to boxes to mix in is limiting

comments.description: array of comment objects, this comment will applied on layout objects and replace existing comments there

tags.description: dictionary of tag array, the additional tags will be applied on the existing layout and can be used for instance to define display formats

formats.description: Be careful it can mess up the stype of the picture! This allows to overwrite global formats in an available step. It can be helpful in cases this step wants to highlight things, that are visual pressed back by existing formats

formatVariations.description: Set of formats that overwrites the style of boxes, if specific conditions are met

StepComment.description: definition of a comment to be mixed-in in steps

layoutId.description: layoutId where this comment is put to

commentLabel.description: optional label that's replaced by this

BoxMixin.description: definition of a box to be mixed in

reference.description: either ID or caption of the box where this mixin is placed before or after

putBefore.description: triggers the new mixin elemente to put either left or above the object with the given reference

putAfter.description: triggers the new mixin elemente to put either right or below the object with the given reference

wrapSubElems.description: use this field if you want to wrap existing horizontal or vertical containers in it's own box.
